issue.title: Honor validation observation policy in 3D and cube texture operations
issue.body:
*Written by Codex on behalf of @segovb.*

Native texture creation and cube-face view creation do not consistently honor
the context's validation-observation policy. A context wrapping an existing
device selects `Uncaptured`, but the operations below still push a validation
scope and wait indefinitely for device progress. On a device shared with a
continuously submitting renderer, this can block on unrelated work.

This behavior predates #988: the same paths ignored the former
`blocking_validation` flag. That PR introduces the shared
`ValidationObservation` and `ValidationScope` owners and applies them to
whole-texture format views, but leaves these existing gaps unresolved. This
issue tracks completing policy enforcement, rather than a regression
introduced by #988.

## Affected operations

The following references pin the inspected PR revision:

- [`Texture3d::new`](https://github.com/adventure-simulator-group/fabelgeist/blob/ef7630d757a6994297f6d24840991cda61bda63c/crates/fabelgeist-gpu/src/data/gpu/texture/texture_3d/mod.rs#L90).
- [`TextureCube::new`](https://github.com/adventure-simulator-group/fabelgeist/blob/ef7630d757a6994297f6d24840991cda61bda63c/crates/fabelgeist-gpu/src/data/gpu/texture/texture_cube/mod.rs#L114).
- [`TextureCube::face_view_with_format`](https://github.com/adventure-simulator-group/fabelgeist/blob/ef7630d757a6994297f6d24840991cda61bda63c/crates/fabelgeist-gpu/src/data/gpu/texture/texture_cube/mod.rs#L293),
  when given a context.

## Intended change and acceptance

- Route these operations through the context's shared validation policy,
  reusing `ValidationScope::new` and its completion/error handling.
- With `Uncaptured`, do not create a blocking validation scope or perform a
  validation-only wait. Leave validation reporting to the device provider.
- With `BlockingScopes`, finish the scope even when polling fails, retain both
  polling and captured validation failures, and propagate the structured error.
- Retain the context-free cube-face path and browser behavior without adding
  synchronous waits. Update the owning documentation to describe the completed
  policy coverage and verify the applicable native and browser checks.

Readback completion and submission backpressure are separate operations: their
required waits should not be disabled by a validation-observation policy.

The evidence is a source comparison, not a runtime reproduction of a hang.
Related work: #988 and #826.
